basic_info.description: Exquisitely renovated Beaux Arts residence in the heart of Pacific Heights, just 1.5 blocks to Fillmore's shops and cafes, nestled between both Alta Plaza and Lafayette parks. This grand, light-filled, ~5,400 sqft home offers 5BDs/4.5BAs, and a lush resort style south-facing garden. A gracious foyer leads to a spacious living rm with built-ins and multiple entertaining spaces. The open kitchen features a Sub-Zero fridge, Wolf range, built in 2nd Wolf oven and microwave, Miele dishwasher, and walk-in pantry with extra large wine fridge, ice maker, and second Miele dishwasher - perfect for large families and entertaining! The kitchen area flows to a sunny Ipe deck and bamboo-lined patio for seamless indoor/outdoor living. A spacious studio/den and a marble powder room complete this level. So much space = flexibility / numerous layouts depending on how you live! Upstairs: 4BDRs/3BAs, including a serene primary suite with fireplace, private balcony, Calacatta spa bath w steam shower, and dual WICs. Downstairs: a soundproof media room with kitchenette, 5thBDR, 4th full BA, laundry, and private deck with garden access, hot tub, and both interior + private entry. Extensive foundation, design + system upgrades. 2 car garage, Nest, Lutron, Savant. WalkScore 97. Pacific Heights dream!
